pin.title: Nasrec Road, Riverlea (approx.): road collapses after heavy rain, closed between Main Reef Road and Dunlin Drive, 25 Nov
pin.location_note: APPROX. Nasrec Road, Riverlea, closed between Main Reef Road and Dunlin Drive (JMPD via both reports). Pin is the Nasrec Road, Riverlea point from Nominatim (-26.2155, 27.9848), beside the Dunlin Drive end of the closed section. The collapse point is not given. Street level, about 800 m.
